description: Na₂Nb₄Se₄O₁₉ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.89 Å. There are two inequivalent Nb sites. In the first Nb site, Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form corner-sharing NbO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 4-7°. There are a spread of Nb-O bond distances ranging from 1.83-2.19 Å. In the second Nb site, Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form corner-sharing NbO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-10°. There are a spread of Nb-O bond distances ranging from 1.84-2.19 Å. There are two inequivalent Se sites. In the first Se site, Se is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three O atoms. There are two shorter (1.73 Å) and one longer (1.75 Å) Se-O bond length. In the second Se site, Se is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of Se-O bond distances ranging from 1.68-1.79 Å. There are ten inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to one Nb and one Se atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Nb, and one Se atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Nb, and one Se atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Nb and one Se atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Nb and one Se atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to three equivalent Na and one Se atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₃Se tetrahedra. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a linear geometry to two equivalent Nb atoms. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a linear geometry to two Nb atoms. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a linear geometry to two equivalent Nb atoms. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a linear geometry to two equivalent Nb atoms.
